{{Top|leg}}
The '''durasteel underlay''' was an enhancement made from [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] that increased the protection capabilities of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] against physical damage, albeit to a lesser degree than the [[ballistic shielding]]. The Mark I, II, III, IV, & V versions in turn allowed for minor increases in protection. However, the added safeguards impaired the movement of the wearer.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', this upgrade can be used on all types of armor, except for robes.
